line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

decision: R2143/R2144: three explicit headers avoid USER private PCH/CSR dependencies that fail the P218 product compile. R2146: WOW32 owns gpsi as a DWORD guest address returned during registration, while original USER defines a native server pointer under the same external name. R2148: original resource and allocator globals initialize addresses of unavailable private callbacks; the selected WOW path obtains callbacks through the existing registration table. P218 traced their actual providers and restored ordinary data separately. No duplicate callback table is needed.

verification.scope: Fresh baseline hash, filtered source difference and logical line check; prior compiler controls cited in decision. No production change or new runtime test.
